sources.title: NetCDF Climate and Forecast Metadata Conventions 1.13
lockedClaims: Bounds specify interval or cell extent; without bounds overlap, gaps and extent cannot be assumed.
Cell methods distinguish extensive accumulated precipitation from intensive precipitation rate.
Accumulated precipitation requires a fully specified time interval and is interpreted as a sum over that interval.

sources.title: Storm Water Management Model User's Manual Version 5.2
lockedClaims: Runoff computation, flow routing and result reporting have distinct time-step settings.
Excessive continuity error can arise from computational time steps that are too long.
Continuity compares initial storage plus inflow with final storage plus outflow.

independenceNote: CF metadata semantics and EPA SWMM numerical guidance are distinct documentation roots. The CPU fixture is a reproducible derivation, not independent physical observation.
